snippet.title: సన్యాసిగా మారిన కొడుకు.. భిక్ష అడిగితే కన్నీళ్లు పెట్టుకున్న తల్లి! | Yogi Adityanath Mother Story
snippet.description:
ఉత్తరప్రదేశ్ ముఖ్యమంత్రి యోగి ఆదిత్యనాథ్ తల్లి సావిత్రి దేవి ఇక లేరు. 91 ఏళ్ల వయసులో ఆమె కన్నుమూశారు.

అయితే ఆమె జీవితంలో జరిగిన ఒక భావోద్వేగ సంఘటన ఇప్పుడు అందరి దృష్టిని ఆకర్షిస్తోంది.

అజయ్ సింగ్ బిష్ట్‌గా జన్మించిన యోగి ఆదిత్యనాథ్ 1994లో సన్యాసం స్వీకరించి కుటుంబ జీవితానికి దూరమయ్యారు. ఆ తర్వాత సన్యాస సంప్రదాయంలో భాగంగా తన తల్లి దగ్గర భిక్ష స్వీకరించిన సంఘటన వారి కుటుంబ జ్ఞాపకాలలో ప్రత్యేక స్థానం సంపాదించుకుంది.

తన కన్న కొడుకు సన్యాసి రూపంలో ఇంటి ముందు నిలబడటం చూసిన తల్లి సావిత్రి దేవి భావోద్వేగానికి గురయ్యారు.

కాలం గడిచింది. కొడుకు ఉత్తరప్రదేశ్ ముఖ్యమంత్రి అయ్యారు. 2022 మే 3న తన స్వగ్రామానికి వెళ్లి తల్లి ఆశీర్వాదం తీసుకున్నారు.

కొడుకు ఎంతటి ఉన్నత స్థాయికి ఎదిగినా, సావిత్రి దేవి మాత్రం తన గ్రామంలో సాధారణ జీవితాన్నే గడిపారు.

ఒక తల్లి ప్రేమ, కొడుకు ఎంచుకున్న సన్యాస మార్గం, వారి మధ్య కొనసాగిన అనుబంధం గురించి తెలుసుకుందాం.

ఓం శాంతి 🙏

ନିଜର ସରଳତା, ଦେଶୀ ରୋଷେଇ ଏବଂ ମାଟି ହାଣ୍ଡିର ଯାଦୁରେ ସିଆ କିପରି ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ମନ ଜିତିଲା ଏବଂ ବିଦେଶୀ ଅତିଥିଙ୍କୁ ମୁଗ୍ଧ କରିଦେଲା, ଦେଖନ୍ତୁ ଏହି ସୁନ୍ଦର ଓଡ଼ିଆ ପାରିବାରିକ କାହାଣୀ।

ଏହି ଭିଡିଓରେ ଆପଣ ଶିଖିବେ ସ୍ୱାଦିଷ୍ଟ Amritsari Dal Makhani Recipe ମଧ୍ୟ।

snippet.title: ভিডিও ২৪৩ | স্বাধীন গোপালগঞ্জ! সে কি ফেরবে নাকি ফিরবেনা?
snippet.description:
স্বাধীন গোপালগঞ্জ! সে কি ফিরবে নাকি ফিরবে না? | ভিডিও ২৪৩
শেখ হাসিনা কি সত্যিই বাংলাদেশে ফিরতে চান? তাঁর পাসপোর্ট না থাকলে দেশে ফেরার আইনি পথ কী? কেন ট্রাভেল পাসের পরিবর্তে প্রত্যর্পণের কথা বলা হচ্ছে?
বাংলাদেশের সংবিধানের ৩৬ অনুচ্ছেদ নাগরিকের দেশে ফিরে আসার অধিকার স্বীকার করেছে; তবে আইনসম্মত বিধিনিষেধ সাপেক্ষে।
অন্যদিকে বাংলাদেশ পাসপোর্ট আদেশ, ১৯৭৩-এর ৬ অনুচ্ছেদে নির্দিষ্ট পরিস্থিতিতে পাসপোর্ট বা ভ্রমণ নথি প্রত্যাখ্যানের বিধান রয়েছে।

তাহলে প্রশ্ন;
- একজন দণ্ডপ্রাপ্ত বাংলাদেশি নাগরিক স্বেচ্ছায় দেশে ফিরে আত্মসমর্পণ করতে চাইলে আইনি ব্যবস্থা কী?
- প্রত্যর্পণ ছাড়া দেশে ফেরার অন্য কোনো আইনসম্মত পথ রয়েছে কি?
- শেখ হাসিনাকে ট্রাভেল পাস দেওয়ার ক্ষেত্রে সুনির্দিষ্ট আইনি বাধা কী?
- সরকার কি বিকল্প পথগুলো পরীক্ষা করেছে?

ভিডিও ২৪৩-এ এসব প্রশ্নের আইনি ও রাজনৈতিক দিক নিয়ে আলোচনা করেছি।
এটি কোনো ব্যক্তির পক্ষে বা বিপক্ষে অবস্থান নয়; আইনের প্রয়োগ, নাগরিক অধিকার এবং সরকারের জবাবদিহি নিয়ে প্রশ্ন।

আমি শরিফ; আপনার হয়ে প্রশ্ন করি, ভয় পাই না।

আপনার মতামত মন্তব্যে জানান। যুক্তি দিয়ে আলোচনা করুন।

Cloudy skies are forecast for Sunday in Wellington, with temperatures reaching a high of 19°C and a minimal 10% chance of rain. Light northerly winds around 13 mph will blow across the Basin Reserve.

snippet.title: Why Isn't Cuba Part of the USA? 🇺🇸🇨🇺
snippet.description:
Cuba is only 94 miles from Florida. The United States tried to buy it, planned to take it by force, and beat Spain in a war there. So why is Cuba not part of the USA?

The names and dates the video leaves out:
- 1823: John Quincy Adams, then Secretary of State, compared Cuba to an apple that would one day fall from Spain's tree to the United States.
- 1848: President James K. Polk offered Spain up to 100 million dollars for Cuba. Spain's answer: no government there could even think of selling it.
- 1854: three American diplomats (James Buchanan, John Y. Mason and Pierre Soulé) wrote the secret report known as the Ostend Manifesto. It leaked, and anti-slavery Americans attacked it; the Republican platform of 1856 called it "the highwayman's plea".
- 1898: the promise is the Teller Amendment (20 April 1898). Congress said the United States had no intention to keep Cuba and would "leave the government and control of the island to its people".
- 10 December 1898: in the Treaty of Paris, Spain gave up Cuba and handed Puerto Rico, Guam and the Philippines to the United States.
- 20 May 1902: Cuba became a republic, after more than three years of American occupation.
- 1901-1903: the "two things" are in the Platt Amendment (a right to intervene in Cuba, and land for naval stations). Guantanamo Bay was leased in 1903 for 2,000 dollars a year in gold.
- 1934: a new treaty ended the right to intervene and kept the base.
- The rent today is 4,085 dollars a year. In 2015 a Cuban diplomat told Reuters that Cuba does not cash the cheques.

Kept simple in the video: "America's leaders" were sure Cuba would come to them one day, but Adams also wrote that the country was not ready for it yet. The reasons Congress made the promise of 1898 are still argued by historians. "Send soldiers at any time" is our short way to say the right to intervene, which the United States used in 1906. Uncle Sam stands for the United States; he is not a real person.

Sources:
- John Quincy Adams to Hugh Nelson, 28 April 1823 (Writings of John Quincy Adams, vol. 7)
- Thomas Jefferson to James Monroe, 24 October 1823 (Writings of Thomas Jefferson, vol. 10)
- The Diary of James K. Polk, vol. 3, and James Buchanan to Romulus Saunders, 17 June 1848 (Works of James Buchanan, vol. 8)
- Pedro J. Pidal to Angel Calderon de la Barca, 16 September 1848 (Manning, Diplomatic Correspondence of the United States: Inter-American Affairs, vol. 11)
- The Ostend Report, October 1854 (Works of James Buchanan, vol. 9)
- Republican Party platform, 17 June 1856
- Joint Resolution of 20 April 1898 (30 Stat. 738), as quoted in The Pedro, 175 U.S. 354 (1899)
- William McKinley, Message to Congress, 11 April 1898
- Treaty of Peace between the United States and Spain, Paris, 10 December 1898
- Platt Amendment, March 1901
- Agreement for the lease of lands for coaling and naval stations, 16 and 23 February 1903, and the lease of 2 July 1903
- Treaty of Relations between the United States and Cuba, 29 May 1934
- Daniel Trotta, "Cuba's top diplomat for U.S. sees long road to normal ties", Reuters, 16 August 2015
- Library of Congress, "The World of 1898: The Spanish-American War"
- French Ensor Chadwick, The Relations of the United States and Spain: Diplomacy (1909)

With ears perked up and an excited tail wag, he rushes down the hallway to provide the ultimate homecoming welcome.

It is truly amazing to see such a loyal companion master the art of opening the front door to let his favorite person inside. This charming interaction captures the beautiful bond between a dog and their owner, highlighting just how smart and attentive our furry friends can be. From the initial chime to the joyful reunion at the entryway, every second of this video is sure to bring a smile to your face and warmth to your heart. 🌻 DANDY’S WORLD 1.0 IS FINALLY HERE 😭

Bro this update finally dropped and there's actually so much new stuff to check out. We got The Labs, new floors, Dessa and Dioda, new cards, new Twisteds and a bunch of other stuff.

In this video I'm checking out the new 1.0 update and showing everything they added. The Labs is actually pretty interesting and there's a lot to explore so let's see what this update is all about 😭

🧪 THE LABS
The Labs is the new game mode they added, and it has 11 floors to go through. There's new stuff on every floor so we're gonna be checking all of that out.

🌻 DESSA & DIODA
We finally got 2 new Toons, Dessa and Dioda! Both of them are new to the game and there's also their Twisteds.

👹 NEW TWISTEDS
Twisted Dessa and Twisted Dioda are also here, so we're gonna see what they look like and how they work in the new update.

🃏 NEW CARDS
They added new Lab Cards too which you can use during your runs. There's a lot of new stuff with the cards so I'm gonna check those out as well.

🧪 AMBROSIA
There's also a new currency called Ambrosia which is used in The Labs.

🔥 AND A LOT MORE:
🌻 Dandy's World 1.0
🧪 The Labs
🏢 11 new floors
🌻 Dessa & Dioda
👹 New Twisteds
🃏 New cards
🧪 Ambrosia
🛗 New Break Room
🏆 Alpha rewards
📖 New lore

There's a lot in this update so make sure you watch till the end because we're checking out pretty much everything new 😭
